name: ShadowStarter
source:
So... you've been kidnapped by a dragon and taken to hell?

And—apparently—they can't be killed! So guess you'll just uh, have to talk your way out... maybe?

ShadowStarter is a totally-free, totally-standalone, dialogue-driven boss encounter with Shadow, who definitely doesn't have any ulterior motives or anything!

I mean, they are a strong, independent dragon who wouldn't possibly need your hugs, let alone your pity, okay!?

OKAY!?

ShadowStarter should take approximately 30 minutes to complete, give or take, depending on your playstyle... well, if Shadow doesn't keep you hostage for all of eternity, that is! 

Play at your own risk. 💀

---

Created by Spiritguide Games
Game can be played for free here: https://spiritguide-games.itch.io/shadowstarter
